Former French Minister Dati Faces Trial in Renault-Nissan Corruption Case

Former French minister Rachida Dati is on trial in Paris for alleged corruption related to her time as CEO of the Renault-Nissan group. The charges involve accusations of misuse of public funds and undeclared benefits. Dati has denied the allegations. The trial is also expected to touch upon the broader context of the Renault-Nissan alliance and its former CEO, Carlos Ghosn, who is currently a fugitive and did not attend the proceedings.
